name: dsh-windows-settlement-proof
description: Content-addressed proof that an approved Windows control-plane change settled across required surfaces

interface.shortDescription: Verify redacted Windows change settlement receipts.
interface.longDescription: Verifies explicit offline receipts for Windows service, task, event and policy surfaces against an approved content-addressed lock without executing commands or returning Windows payloads.
interface.defaultPrompt: Verify this explicit Windows settlement manifest and report only hashed evidence.
